# Constraints for the notebook execution job only (.github/workflows/notebooks.yml, `pip install
# -c`). They pin the plotting and numeric stack and the kernel stack to the versions the committed
# template outputs were produced with (Python 3.14), so a new release of any of them cannot turn
# every notebook red at once on main (a warning on stderr, a changed repr, moved figure geometry).
# pyproject.toml stays unpinned. Authors install with the same file before they execute a notebook
# and commit its outputs: pip install -e ".[dev,ml]" -c .github/constraints-notebooks.txt
#
# Bumping any line here is a foundation change: re-execute every notebook
# (`python tools/execute_notebook.py recipes/<folder>`), commit the results, and read the
# freshness check's output. See docs/notebook-ci.md.
